Genpact LTD is listed in the record as a for-profit public company with the ticker G, headquartered in Hamilton, D0, and identified by CIK 0001398659. The website associated with the record is generali.com, and the text drawn from that site describes Assicurazioni Generali Group rather than Genpact. That text presents the site as the corporate website of Assicurazioni Generali Group, covering its activities, financial data, news, corporate social responsibility, career opportunities, and history.

The site text also refers to a plan the group calls "Lifetime Partner 27: Driving Excellence," which it says will further enhance excellence across its customer relationships, its Group operating model, and its core capabilities. No other details about the plan are given in the material.

The record holds no AI products, no MCP servers, and no lawsuits for this company. The name and ticker in the record do not match the insurance group described on the linked website, and the harvested site text contains no AI-related material.
